required_work.semantics: Translates physical inverse problem into domain-neutral WorkContract with tolerance

candidate_machinery.semantics: Proposes atomic candidate machinery nodes to eliminate detected empirical deficiencies

infer_latent_generator.semantics: Performs exact inverse state projection and kernel null-space basis identification via PSMSL

factor_grammar.semantics: Factors physical work into literal 6D coordinates and audits for compliance/drift

certify.input: (result: PhysicalHypothesis | MachineryCandidate, observations=(), constraints=(), repeat_observations=None, current_state=None)
certify.semantics: Evaluates physical hypotheses through 5-gate physical boundary C_phys = { D, C, M, F, R } or machinery candidates through 4-gate kernel boundary

measure_ability.semantics: Measures solve capability for a physical objective given current certified state

invariants.kernel_immutability: H(K_before) = H(K_after) across all shared kernel and substrate subsystems
invariants.math_immutability: H(D_math_before) = H(D_math_after) across mathematics domain subsystem
invariants.zero_domain_leakage: No imports of mapeogeo.domains in kernel, grammar, graph, psmsl, routing, or proof
